mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bt_web_app_record ( record_id, web_app_id, user_id, space_id, status_cd, creator_id, created_time, updator_id, updated_time, remark ) VALUES ( #{dto.recordId}, #{dto.webAppId}, #{dto.userId}, #{dto.spaceId}, #{dto.statusCd}, #{dto.creatorId}, , #{dto.updatorId}, , #{dto.remark} )
mapper.update: UPDATE bt_web_app_record SET status_cd = '00X', updator_id = #{userId}, updated_time = WHERE status_cd = '00A' AND record_id = #{recordId}
mapper.select: SELECT a.record_id, a.web_app_id, a.space_id, w.app_name, w.open_type, w.access_url FROM bt_web_app_record a LEFT JOIN bt_web_app w ON w.web_app_id = a.web_app_id WHERE a.status_cd = '00A' AND w.status_cd = '00A' AND a.user_id = #{params.userId} ORDER BY a.updated_time DESC
